lines.zh: 我慢慢地往前挪，壳很重。
lines.en: I creep forward, my shell heavy.
I leave a bright trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我爬过一片叶子，叶在抖。
lines.en: I crawl across a leaf, and it trembles.
I slide off the stone to the ground.
I extend a pair of tentacles to scout.
I head toward the damp.
One step takes me a long time.

lines.zh: 我的壳在暗里自己发光。
lines.en: My shell glows on its own in the dark.
I go around a clod and keep going.
The light on my back wavers.
I pass through the grass.
I climb a twig, slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着一根草茎往上爬。
lines.en: I climb up a single blade of grass.
I work my way up the stone wall.
Where I shift, my light shifts too.
I crawl steadily on wet mud.
I pull into my shell for a moment.
My light dims and brightens.

lines.zh: 叶背的凉气让我慢下来。
lines.en: The cool underside of the leaf slows me.
I can feel the dampness.
I'm waiting for rain.
My shell has rings on it.
I'm small, and slow.
I've drawn my tentacles in.
I stay in the stone crack; it's cool.
A bug crawls by; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我的光在苔藓上照出一小块。
lines.en: My light makes a small patch on the moss.
I'm climbing slowly upward.
I hear a drop of water.

lines.zh: 我伏在苔藓最厚的地方。
lines.en: I rest where the moss is thickest.

lines.zh: 我往前伸了一点，又缩回。
lines.en: I reach forward a little, then pull back.
At night I shine clearest.
Your lamp is brighter than I am.
I raise my head; a tentacle stirs.
Are you going to step on me?
My light is small, isn't it?
Only when you crouch do I dare move.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很轻，我听得见。
lines.en: Your steps are light, but I hear them.
Do you have water on your hands?
Even in your shadow I'm not dark.
You're crouched too close; I retract.
I slowly pull back into my shell.
I've never smelled you before.
I'm still deciding whether to move.

lines.zh: 壳口我封了一层薄黏液。
lines.en: I seal my shell's opening with a film of slime.
Only a fleck of light on my shell now.
A thin crack on my shell.
I roll half a turn and stop.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地伸出头，又缩回。
lines.en: I put my head out slowly, then draw it back.
I don't cry out; I can't.
I press under a leaf.
One tentacle is half drawn in.
I leak a little slime.
I'm alive, only slower.
That cabbage leaf looks tender.
Water in your hand; I smell it.
Damp places; I like them.
I stretch my tentacles that way.
Lower the greens a little.
That glow draws me over.
I smell moss.
I crawl over, very slowly.
If there's food, I'll stay.
Wait for me a while longer.
You washed the greens; they still drip.
I smell salt on your hands.
That dampness draws me forward.
Under the leaf is cooler; I like it.
I won't compete; I'll wait for you to leave.
Set it out, then step back.
You touch my shell, and the light wavers.
I pull into my shell and freeze.

lines.zh: 我被推得滑出去一小段。
lines.en: I'm shoved and slide a short way.
I creep away from your feet.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在石头上，响了一下。
lines.en: My shell knocks the stone, once.

lines.zh: 你落脚的风把我掀歪了。
lines.en: The wind of your step tips me over.
I flatten and pose as a pebble.
We touch once; I'm soft.

lines.zh: 我从你的鞋面上爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl over your shoe.
You step back, and only then do I put my head out.
Her glow rests against the rim of my shell.
Her light is a little greener.
We crawl side by side, slowly.
Our trails merge into one.
She touches her tentacles to mine.
We cling to the leaf's underside together.
Her shell is a size smaller.
We wait for rain together.
Two small lights, very close.
We understand without words.
I take a cabbage leaf, slowly.
I push away the seed you dropped.
I pick up a bit of moss.
I sip a little from a dewdrop.
I drag a leaf along.

lines.zh: 我把你的纽扣顶了一下。
lines.en: I nudge your button.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片花瓣，盖在壳上。
lines.en: I pick up a petal and lay it on my shell.
I push grains of soil into a heap.
I bite a blade of grass; it won't give.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的果子推到一边。
lines.en: I push the fallen fruit aside.
That leaf; I'll go there.
I smell water ahead.
I extend my tentacles and set my course.

lines.zh: 那边有个亮点，不是我的。
lines.en: There's a light there, not mine.
I've started crawling; it will take a while.
I take the flattest route.
That spot is damp enough.
That damp patch — I crawl toward it.
My light leans that way.
I've remembered that stone.
I creep over inch by inch.
My trail lengthens behind me.
I stop and change direction.
I go around that stone.
A little way still to go.
I stretch my tentacles far.
I can't see well, but I can smell.
I probe forward slowly.

lines.zh: 那片叶子有虫咬过的洞。
lines.en: That leaf has holes bitten in it.
One more small step.
I scrape the leaf's edge with my radula.
I butt it with my shell.
I press my body onto it.
There's almost no force in that.
I push that leaf.
I bite its edge and drag.
I pull into my shell and dodge.
It turns over; I crawl on top.
I nibble once more.
I stop and catch my breath.
I put my head out of the shell.
It's damp here; perfect.
My light comes on for the first time.
I creep forward.
I'm under a stone.
Water on the leaf; I drink first.
I move my tentacles once.
The night wind is cool, and my shell brighter.
I cross a little moss.
I see a light far off.
At the first heat, my shell turns pale.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf and my shell takes a knock.
Water rises; I shrink into my shell.

lines.zh: 冲击掀得我连壳翻起来。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, shell and all.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的壳，白了一道。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shell, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 有光罩住我，我的光更暗了。
lines.en: A light covers me, and mine dims further.
Without leaves, I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我缩得只剩壳。
lines.en: The flash is so bright I shrink to shell only.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，没有石头。
lines.en: No leaves here, and no stones.
